name: Pinned editorial export handoff
description: Keep the content-side web handoff as a read-only JSON export with contractVersion 1, an immutable 40-character sourceRevision, unique id/locale entries, and deterministic validation. Adapters must fail closed with ready, stale, missing, or error outcomes.

outcomes.notes: Verified current docs/editorial-export-contract.md and schema/editorial-export.schema.json against the record; the v1 immutable revision, unique id/locale, read-only boundary, and fail-closed outcomes remain documented. Test: devenv shell -- bun test tests/export_contract.test.mjs passed 5/5. Content repo documents adapter semantics but does not implement the web adapter.
outcomes.test_results: devenv shell -- bun test tests/export_contract.test.mjs: 5 passed, 0 failed.
